title: No BG values are displayed when Dexcom app shows "low"
symptom: When the Dexcom app displays "low" during a hypo, AAPS does not display any BG values, and there is a gap in Nightscout as well. The logs show that a value of 37 was received and submitted, but it is not displayed.
cause: The value 37 is an error value from Dexcom, not a real BG reading. xDrip also shows this as an invalid value.
evidence_quote: low is not BG but error value (37 in numbers)
